ns2:course.label: Advanced Computer Networks
ns2:course.description: Advanced concepts in computer networks, including congestion control, quality of service, naming, routing, wireless networks, Internet architecture, measurement, network security, and selected recent research directions. Prerequisite: CS 438.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, or NDEG:Computer Science Onl-UIUC.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
